steps.message: Draft a chase-up message for ORD-114 to its production partner. I haven’t provided a recipient.

reply.answer:
The draft is ready on a card for your confirmation — recipient left blank, as you didn't name the production partner. ORD-114 (Hoodie, 2,000 pcs for Northwind Apparel) was due 23 March 2026, so it's 9 calendar days overdue and last recorded activity was 30 March; the message asks for status and expected completion, without promising a date.

Source: track1/data/orders.csv row 85.

result.message: All facts above are computed from the cited rows; recent stage output is factory-wide context, not per-order progress.

arguments.text:
Subject: Status check – ORD-114 (Hoodie, 2,000 pieces)

Hello,

I'm following up on our order ORD-114 for 2,000 hoodies (Northwind Apparel), which was due on 23 March 2026 and is now 9 calendar days overdue. The order is currently shown at the packing stage, with last recorded activity on 30 March 2026.

Could you let me know where things stand and when the order is expected to be finished and ready for dispatch? If anything is holding it up on your side, please tell me so we can work out the next step together.

Thanks,
[Your name]
